decisions.boundary_condition: Apply this only to departure timing; do not infer flexibility across all time-of-day windows or assume the same timing for every leg.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer afternoon flight departures when no different timing is specified for the current leg.
decisions.condition: When searching for flights and no different departure-time preference is specified for the current leg.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize flights departing in the afternoon, including the earliest suitable afternoon option when relevant.
decisions.exception_condition: Follow any explicitly stated timing for the current leg, and confirm before broadening beyond afternoon when availability or other constraints require it.
decisions.name: Prefers afternoon flight departures
decisions.rationale: Repeated requests across multiple flight conversations consistently favor afternoon departures, supporting a reusable soft default while preserving explicit per-leg timing and availability exceptions.
